purpose: Teach: 追記/新装/賞与/取り調べ/動員/次期/顕著/買い付け

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文に、本気で、絶対、追記、絶対、必要な部分、絶対、見直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren, I need you to review the sections of your paper that absolutely need revision. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Firm without raised voice. Emphasise 'absolutely' with quiet conviction. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. Clear expectation, not anger.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、新装、絶対、設備、絶対、活用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the opportunity to use the newly equipped lab facilities.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slightly formal register. Measured pace. A careful acknowledgement that shows he's heard the weight of what was asked. Not deferential, but serious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究員への、本気で、絶対、賞与、絶対、検討、絶対、教授、絶対、と、絶対、相談しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Discuss the researcher bonus consideration with the department head. Make sure it happens.
lines.style: Instructional but not condescending. Slight pause before the key request. Steady eye contact level. This is less a suggestion than a clear directive wrapped in courtesy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。事件関連の、本気で、絶対、取り調べ、絶対、報告、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've addressed the case-related investigation materials in the paper. Thank you for that guidance.
lines.style: Quiet confidence with underlying care. He's showing he understood what mattered. No rush in the pacing. Genuine gratitude, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究人員の、本気for、絶対、動員、絶対、計画、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Put together a plan for allocating your research staff. I want it done properly.
lines.style: Clear authority. Economical with words. The rhythm suggests no room for negotiation, but the tone isn't harsh. A request that carries expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。次期、本気で、絶対、学長、絶対、選挙、絶対、注目しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm watching how the upcoming presidential election might affect the department. I appreciate the heads-up.
lines.style: Thoughtful, somewhat measured. A pause before the key phrase suggests he's connecting the dots. Respectful but showing he understands the larger context. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、顕著、絶対、な、絶対、新規性、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Aim for clear novelty in your paper. Make it stand out on that front.
lines.style: Encouraging beneath the instruction. Slight lift in the final clause. The tone of someone who believes the person can do it. Not a complaint, but an investment in the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究機材の、本気で、絶対、買い付け、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're already moving forward with ordering the research equipment. I'm grateful for your support.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the acknowledgement. Calm, steady delivery. The closing feels settled — not rushed, not lingering. Shows competence without boasting.
